title: skills: a JSON form beside the TypeScript in the sections served to MCP clients, and a pin on those section headings
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

A client building through MCP writes JSON. The sections the hosted door serves it are illustrated in TypeScript, with `import` lines, so the client translates every example by itself. And those sections are found by their heading text: rename one here and the hosted product fails at start.

Who acts: the skills lane (`skills/objectstack-{data,ui,automation}/**`), plus a framework-side pin. Governed surface.

## Evidence

- Code fences in the six metadata skills: 204 TypeScript, 2 JSON. NocoBase's skills, the nearest analogue, carry 454 JSON fences to 269 TypeScript.
- The hosted door reads 24 sections of the data, UI and automation skills by exact heading text and serves them verbatim, TypeScript fences included. A renamed or duplicated heading throws at module load there.
- No check in this repository knows which headings are read.

## Scope

- Each of the 24 sections gains the item's JSON form beside its TypeScript form, or a form neutral to both.
- A list of the 24 headings lives in this repository, and a check fails here when one is renamed, removed or duplicated. The list of sections is on the cloud handover card.
- File surface: the three skills, one list file, one check script.

## Done when

- Every one of the 24 sections reads correctly to a client that has no TypeScript project.
- Renaming a pinned heading fails in this repository's CI.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Decision record: #34691 S3 = A. Related: #34690 (the hosted half).
- Dedup, open and closed: none found for `skills JSON examples MCP`.
